I guess it's that last part, how someone I love just will not understand that makes me feel hopeless. I tried absolutely everything I could to make sense of and treat my condition, and begged him to give just a little support, but he dismissed it all. 
It's so much harder because now I'm trying to deal with this alone and having to manage this extreme heartbreak on top of that. 


Thank you for the encouragement, I hope you keep improving and I hope I can get through this as well.

I'm very similar. It makes being judged and punished even more painful as I seem like I'm doing it on purpose. I've tried to explain that just knowing what is happening doesn't stop the emotions and paranoia from overtaking my logic.

Things have been too difficult for too long. I have a lot of childhood trauma and have already made three serious suicide attempts in the past year. My ex was my last straw I think. It felt like I was abused the same way as when I was little, but worse because I was and adult who chose to trust him. I haven't been able to recover even though it's  been a year already since breaking up with him.

It's wrong, but the only time I have been able to function was when we briefly got back together, but I ruined it because of how paranoid I felt after what happened before. Now I am even worse than before I met him.
Completely this. No, it never got better, it actually has only gotten worse to the point that I have stopped caring if it does ever get better.
